title: Care Coordination and Delivery Weeks Before a Prior Authorization End Date
content:
**Care Management coordination bulletin — delivery capacity after a Prior Authorization provider change**

**Rule.** The delivery weeks of a provider change of a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization approval follow the member's care coordination, and set the units the new provider can deliver before the end date, to which the units a provider change carries over are limited:

- where a care plan update was recorded in the month before the day of the change and the latest care contact was no more than 7 days before that day, the weeks counted are the weeks started between the day of the change and the end date (the days divided by seven and rounded up), multiplied by the class's weekly frequency cap;
- where such a care plan update was recorded but the latest care contact is older than 7 days (8 days or more) or there is none, the new provider's capacity is counted day by day, as the days to the end date multiplied by the weekly frequency cap and divided by seven, rounded down;
- otherwise (no care plan update in that month) the capacity is the whole weeks to the end date (the days divided by seven and rounded down) multiplied by the weekly frequency cap.

**Records read.** The member's Care Management care plan updates with an activity date in the month before the day of the change, and the activity date of the member's latest care contact. The days to the end date are counted from the day of the change to the end date of the approval.

### Condition table

| Care plan update in the month before the change | Latest care contact | Capacity before the end date |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 7 days or fewer before the change | Weeks started (days divided by seven, rounded up) multiplied by the weekly frequency cap |
| Yes | 8 days or more before, or no contact on file | Days multiplied by the weekly frequency cap, divided by seven, rounded down |
| No | Any | Whole weeks (days divided by seven, rounded down) multiplied by the weekly frequency cap |

### Worked cases (hypothetical inputs, for illustration only)

The approval ends 20 days after the day of the change, in a class whose weekly frequency cap is taken as 3 for the example.

- Care plan update last week and a care contact 7 days before the change: 20 days make 3 weeks started (2.86 rounded up), so the capacity is **9 units**.
- Care plan update last week, latest care contact 8 days before: twenty multiplied by three, divided by seven, is 8.57, rounded down to **8 units**.
- No care plan update in the month: 2 whole weeks, so **6 units**.
